note: Excel #NAME? — FLATTEN is Google-Sheets-only, absent in Excel.

LINEST full stats grid: [[1,0],[0,0],[1,0],[#NUM!,2],[5,0]]. Row 4 = [F-stat, df]; F-stat cell is #NUM! (0/0 for a perfect fit, residual df=0 but the emitted df cell shows 2), matching the hypothesis that Excel emits #NUM! for the F-statistic of a perfect fit.
TREND returns [5;6;7] as a column; Excel does not error on the orientation-mismatched new_x.
WRAPROWS pads the trailing slot with #N/A: [[1,2],[3,#N/A]].

SUM=4. The formula-valued grid seed A2="=1/0" was NOT ingested as a live #DIV/0! error cell by the Excel harness — it was seeded inert (treated as text/ignored), so SUM(A1:A3)=1+3=4. This is a grid-seeding fidelity artifact, not live error-propagation: Excel would propagate #DIV/0! from a genuinely error-valued cell. Reconciler note: the fork vs pure-engines (#DIV/0!) is a SEED-FIDELITY divergence, not an engine semantics divergence.
WEEKNUM("2023-01-01",21)=52; Excel coerces the ISO text date.
YEARFRAC text-date coercion → 1.0138888888888888 (365/360).
RANDARRAY(1,3,1,10,TRUE) spills a 1x3 of integers in [1,10] (this run [8,2,5]). Excel supports 5-arg integer-mode. (gsheets #N/A claim not testable in this lane.)
LAMBDA(x,x+1)(5)=6 — inline LAMBDA defined and invoked.
IFERROR(10/{1,0,2},-1) broadcasts and spills [10,-1,5].
IMLOG("8",2)=#NAME? — Excel has no IMLOG (Google-Sheets extension).
IMDIV zero divisor "0+0i" → #NUM! in Excel (error-code is a property of the zero handling, not the spelling).

IMEXP("10+3i")="-21806.035863485+3108.37503049351i" — each component at 15 significant digits. NOTE: hypothesis rough-estimated the real part as ~-21801; the true value is -21806.035863485. The 15-sig-fig-cap claim holds.
DEC2HEX(-1,4)="FFFFFFFFFF" (10 chars) — places arg ignored for negative two’s-complement result.
IMTANH("0")=#NAME? — Excel-absent.
XNPV with ISO-TEXT dates in B1:B2 → #VALUE! (Excel rejects text dates in XNPV).

XIRR with the SAME ISO-TEXT dates → 0.0638231724500656 (computes!). Confirms the Excel internal asymmetry: XIRR coerces text dates whereas XNPV (financial-001) rejects them. This explains the corpus split.
RRI(0,1000,2000)=#NUM! in Excel (nper=0). (gsheets #DIV/0! claim not testable here.)
ACCRINT=295.8333333333333 in Excel. (gsheets 295.5556 / formulas 295.2778 not testable here; Excel value pinned.)
IPMT last-period=4.454951228316506 (small positive). Only the formulas library errors here.
CELL("format",A1) with A1=42 → "G" (General).
ISBLANK(A1)=TRUE when A1 is a typed empty string "" — Excel stores it as a genuinely empty cell.
ISBLANK(A1)=FALSE when A1 holds a FORMULA yielding "" (=""). A formula result is never blank. Together with info-002 this cleanly separates seed-fidelity (typed "") from semantics (formula "").
SHEETS(A1)=1 in Excel for a single-cell reference.
TYPE(A1)=1 (number) for a truly empty cell in Excel.
SORT({3;1;2},1,-1)=[3;2;1] — Excel reads the 3rd arg as sort_order, -1=descending.

AND() returns an EMPTY cell (no value, no error) — Excel rejects it at formula entry as too few arguments, so nothing is stored. Confirms the recorded blank is an entry-rejection artifact, NOT a computed value. Reconciler: treat as non-value, not an error sentinel.
CHOOSE(5,"a","b","c")=#VALUE! (index out of range).
T(TRUE) returns a blank cell (primitive blank/untouched) — not an empty string.
PRODUCT({"2","3","4"})=0 — quoted-number strings inside an array literal are skipped (no factors).
SUM(A1:A3)=0 — numbers-stored-as-text in a range are ignored by SUM.
SUM({TRUE,FALSE,TRUE})=0 — booleans inside an array literal are not coerced.
ADDRESS(1,1,1,TRUE,"Sheet2")="Sheet2!$A$1" (unquoted simple name). Follow-up confirmed: ADDRESS(...,"My Sheet")="'My Sheet'!$A$1" — Excel single-quotes a sheet name containing a space.
FORMULATEXT(A1) with A1=42 (a plain value) → #N/A (Excel returns #N/A when the referenced cell holds no formula).
GETPIVOTDATA("Sales",A1) with no pivot at A1 → #REF! (Excel recognizes the function; the pure engines’ #NAME? is missing-function).

INDEX(A1:A2,5)=#REF! (row out of range). Follow-ups: INDEX(A1:A2,0)=[[1],[2]] (row_num 0 spills the whole column); INDEX(A1:A2,-1)=#VALUE! (negative). So Excel error progression: 0→whole-column spill, negative→#VALUE!, too-large→#REF!.

LOOKUP(2,{1,2,3;"a","b","c"})="b" (wider-than-tall → search first row, return last row). Follow-up: LOOKUP(2,{1,2;3,4}) SQUARE → 2 (Excel treats a square array with VERTICAL orientation: search first column [1;3], approx-match 1 at row 1, return last column row 1 = 2). Excel MATCHES pycel’s "2" here.
UNIQUE(A1:A3) over "Apple"/"apple"/"APPLE" spills a single "Apple" — Excel dedups case-INsensitively and keeps the first-seen casing.
SUM() returns an EMPTY cell — Excel rejects it at entry (SUM needs >=1 argument); no value/error is stored. Confirms the blank is an entry-rejection, not a computed 0.
CONVERT(1,"m","ft")=3.2808398950131235 (full-precision double in Excel).

ACOT(-0.5)=2.0344439357957027 in Excel. MECHANISM confirmed (Excel principal branch in (0,pi): pi+ATAN(1/x)). BUT the hypothesis’s predicted Excel value 2.6779 is WRONG — the true value is 2.0344439357957027 (= pi + ATAN(-2)). Reconciler/wiki: use 2.0344439357957027, discard 2.6779. The gsheets prediction (-0.4636=ATAN(-0.5)) is also suspect if gsheets uses ATAN(1/x)=ATAN(-2)=-1.1071 — needs gsheets confirmation.
ACOT(-100)=3.131592986903128 (approaches pi from below). Matches hypothesis ~3.1316.
ACOT(0)=1.5707963267948966 (pi/2). Both conventions agree at 0.
ACOTH(0.5)=#NUM! (|x|<1 out of domain).
IMLN("2+3i")="1.28247467873077+0.982793723247329i" — 15 significant digits per component.
IMPOWER("i",2)="-1+1.22464679914735E-16i" — uppercase-E residue retained, not cleaned to "-1".
MUNIT(0)=#VALUE! in Excel (invalid 0x0 identity). (gsheets #NUM! not testable here.)
ISNUMBER(RANDBETWEEN(1,10))=TRUE (integer output). Establishes the integer contract that the formulas library violates.
SIN(0)=0 in Excel (baseline). This request is primarily a LibreOffice re-record ask — Excel just anchors that 0 is correct, so the LibreOffice BLANK recording is a harness gap.

INDEX(A1:A3*10) returns an EMPTY cell — Excel rejects single-argument INDEX (row_num is required) at entry, so it does NOT spill and does NOT error-value; it is blank. Verified with controls: even plain INDEX(A1:A3) and INDEX({1;2;3}) are EMPTY, while INDEX(A1:A3,0) spills the whole column. So the mechanism is "row_num omitted => entry rejection => blank", distinct from gsheets which spills the array.

INDEX({1,2,3}+{10;20;30}) returns an EMPTY cell — same single-arg INDEX entry-rejection as spill-broadcast-001 (not the full 3x3 outer product, not an error). gsheets’ full-array spill is the divergent branch.
LEN(B1:B3)*1 auto-spills [3;3;3] in Excel (dynamic array). gsheets implicit-intersection single-3 claim not testable here.
{1,2,3}+{10,20} broadcasts with #N/A padding: [11,22,#N/A].
SORT(SEQUENCE(5),1,-1)=[5;4;3;2;1] descending in Excel.
SUM(1,2,3)=6 (baseline; the LibreOffice blank is a harness gap).
SORT({3;1;2},1,-1)=[3;2;1] descending — bare array literal, clean control for the sort_order divergence.
HYPERLINK("https://example.com","click me") → scalar string "click me" (the display label). Excel exposes a plain string, NOT an opaque rich-link value; joins the gsheets/hyperformula string class.
CONFIDENCE(0.05,1,100)=0.19599639845400538 in Excel (the consensus value). gsheets ~0.1959963986 drift not testable here.
COUNTA(A1:A3)&"|"&COUNTBLANK(A1:A3)="2|1" with A2="" — Excel counts the zero-length string "" as blank (excluded from COUNTA, included in COUNTBLANK).

PERCENTRANK.EXC gives "0.166|0.166666". Default (3 sig) = 0.166 confirming the TRUNCATE convention (not 0.167). NOTE: the 6-significant-digit call returns 0.166666 (also TRUNCATED), NOT the 0.166667 the hypothesis predicted (it assumed rounding). So PERCENTRANK truncates at both precisions.
CHISQ.TEST degenerate single-row → 0.36787944117144233 (=e^-1 = CHISQ.DIST.RT(2,2)), confirming Excel falls back to df = cols-1 = 2 at the boundary.
CHISQ.TEST with 2x3 vs 2x2 shape mismatch → #N/A (ranges must be same shape).
BETA.DIST(1.5,2,2,TRUE,0,1)=#NUM! — x=1.5 is above the upper bound 1 (out of support).
NORM.S.INV(0.99)=2.3263478740408408 (Excel reference).

REGEXEXTRACT(date, "(\\d{4})-(\\d{2})-(\\d{2})")="2025-03-01" (full match by default, capture groups ignored). Follow-up confirmed: return_mode=2 spills the capture groups ["2025","03","01"] as a row.

LENB("あ")=1 on this Western-locale Excel (non-DBCS, 1 byte/char). Follow-ups confirm: MIDB("あいう",3,2)="う", FINDB("い","あいう")=2, LEFTB("あいう",2)="あい" — all *B functions collapse to per-character counting.
CHAR(0)=#VALUE! in Excel (code 0 out of 1..255).
DOLLAR(-1234.5,2)="($1,234.50)" — Excel renders negative currency with accounting parentheses.
